variables.name: mRenderShadowsInCompositor
variables.comment:
If true, shadows drawn around the window will be rendered by the system compositor. If
     * false, shadows will be drawn by the client by setting an elevation on the root view and
     * the contents will be inset by the shadow radius.

variables.name: ENFORCE_EDGE_TO_EDGE
variables.comment:
* Make app go edge-to-edge by default if the target SDK is
     * {@link Build.VERSION_CODES#VANILLA_ICE_CREAM} or above.

variables.name: OVERRIDE_LAYOUT_IN_DISPLAY_CUTOUT_MODE
variables.comment:
* Override the layout in display cutout mode behavior. This will only apply if the edge to edge
     * is not enforced.

variables.name: ENFORCE_EDGE_TO_EDGE_SDK_VERSION
variables.comment: * Since which target SDK version this window is enforced to go edge-to-edge.

variables.name: mContextMenuCallback
variables.comment:
* Simple callback used by the context menu and its submenus. The options
     * menu submenus do not use this (their behavior is more complex).

variables.name: mDecor
variables.comment: This is the top-level view of the window, containing the window decor.

variables.name: mForceDecorInstall
variables.comment: view is requested, so we need to force the recreating without introducing an infinite loop.

variables.name: mContentParent
variables.comment: mDecor itself, or a child of mDecor where the contents go.

variables.name: mContentParentExplicitlySet
variables.comment: null, then the content parent was set due to window preservation.

variables.name: FLAG_RESOURCE_SET_ICON
variables.comment: and should not be overwritten with a default.

variables.name: FLAG_RESOURCE_SET_LOGO
variables.comment: and should not be overwritten with a default.

variables.name: FLAG_RESOURCE_SET_ICON_FALLBACK
variables.comment: as no default was previously specified. Anything can override this.

variables.name: mPreparedPanel
variables.comment:
* The panel that is prepared or opened (the most recent one if there are
     * multiple panels). Shortcuts will go to this panel. It gets set in
     * {@link #preparePanel} and cleared in {@link #closePanel}.

variables.name: mPanelChordingKey
variables.comment:
* The keycode that is currently held down (as a modifier) for chording. If
     * this is 0, there is no key held down.

variables.name: mSupportsPictureInPicture
variables.comment: to see if KEYCODE_WINDOW should be handled here or not.

variables.name: mClipToOutline
variables.comment: Whether window content should be clipped to the background outline.

methods.name: private void updateProgressBars(int value)
methods.comment:
* Updates the progress bars that are shown in the title bar.
     *
     * @param value Can be one of {@link Window#PROGRESS_VISIBILITY_ON},
     *            {@link Window#PROGRESS_VISIBILITY_OFF},
     *            {@link Window#PROGRESS_INDETERMINATE_ON},
     *            {@link Window#PROGRESS_INDETERMINATE_OFF}, or a value
     *            starting at {@link Window#PROGRESS_START} through
     *            {@link Window#PROGRESS_END} for setting the default
     *            progress (if {@link Window#PROGRESS_END} is given,
     *            the progress bar widgets in the title will be hidden after an
     *            animation), a value between
     *            {@link Window#PROGRESS_SECONDARY_START} -
     *            {@link Window#PROGRESS_SECONDARY_END} for the
     *            secondary progress (if
     *            {@link Window#PROGRESS_SECONDARY_END} is given, the
     *            progress bar widgets will still be shown with the secondary
     *            progress bar will be completely filled in.)
